label: Opening Hook
text: In 1959, nine hikers cut their way out of their tent and fled into the snow at night, and none of them survived.
title: File:Dyatlov.Volume 1.Page 370.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Group led by Igor Dyatlov, February 1959, on Kholat Syakhl in the northern Urals The tent was cut open from inside; bodies were found over the following months, some with severe injuries Traces of radioactivity were found on some clothing A 2019-2020 Russian inquiry and a 2021 scientific study point to a slab avalanche Some details are still debated
title: File:Dyatlov.Volume 1.Page 340.jpg
